title: Program semantics predicate
statement: Given a Boolean word $x$, a natural-number bound $B$, a path label $l$, a program register state $σ$, and a proposition $P$, define the predicate to mean that $P$ holds in the nondeterministic semantics of the specified nine-register program, starting at label $l$ with register values $σ$ and no additional configuration data, under register bound $B$.
caveat: The semantics relation and register-bound predicate are not informally defined in the supplied context, so their full mathematical meaning cannot be made explicit.
